auth.login.subtitle: We'll email you a code. No passwords.
auth.email.label: Email
auth.legal: By continuing you accept our Terms and Privacy Policy.
auth.code.title: Check your *email*.
auth.code.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}.
auth.code.label: 6-digit code
auth.totp.title: Verify your *identity*.
auth.totp.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.totp.lost: I don't have my phone · use a backup code
auth.enroll.title: Set up your *second step*.
auth.enroll.subtitle: Scan the code with your authenticator app, or open it from this phone.
auth.backup.title: Save these *codes*.
auth.backup.subtitle: If you lose your phone, each one lets you in once. They won't be shown again.
auth.recover.title: Use a *backup* code.
auth.recover.subtitle: Using it disables your previous authenticator; you'll set up a new one.
auth.recover.label: Backup code
auth.recover.noCodes: I don't have the codes either
auth.reset.title: Request a *reset*.
auth.reset.subtitle: We'll email you to confirm. If nobody cancels it, in 48 hours you'll be able to set up a new authenticator.
auth.session.title: We closed your *session*.
auth.session.subtitle: 30 minutes passed without activity. It's a security measure.
auth.stepup.title: Confirm it's *you*.
auth.stepup.subtitle: This action requires the code from your authenticator app.
auth.evicted.title: It's been a *while*.
auth.evicted.subtitle: Your phone cleared the app's saved data. Just sign in again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.heading: Your *preferences*.
settings.profile.photo.d: Shown to your team and on what you sign.
settings.profile.name: Name
settings.profile.name.d: How you want to be seen.
settings.profile.email.d: Used to sign in and for notices. Changing it asks for your authenticator code and confirms on both addresses.
settings.profile.language.d: Of the app and of the notices we send you.
settings.profile.timezone.d: So the agenda and notices arrive at your time.
settings.security.totp.d.obligatorio: Enabled on {fecha}. Required for your role; it can't be turned off.
settings.security.totp.d.opcional: Enabled on {fecha}. You can turn it off with an authenticator code.
settings.security.totpSecond.d: Another device in case you lose the first.
settings.security.backup.d: {n} of 10 left. Viewing them asks for your authenticator code.
settings.security.signOutAll: Sign out on all my devices
settings.security.signOutAll.d: Including this one. You'll need to sign in again.
settings.security.resetPending.d: You requested an authenticator reset. Expires {fecha}.
settings.appearance.theme.d: Light, dark, or whatever your device uses.
settings.notifications.security.d: New sign-ins, authenticator, backup. Can't be turned off.
settings.assistant.actions: What it can do for me
settings.assistant.actions.d: Choose which actions you allow. It always asks you to confirm.
settings.assistant.night.d: What it may do on its own each morning. Everything can be undone.
settings.team.invite.d: If they're on the team, they'll set up the authenticator when they sign in.
settings.team.role.d: Moving from client to team requires setting up the authenticator.
settings.team.suspend.d: They can no longer sign in. Their data stays.
settings.team.reset2fa.d: Only if they lost the phone and the codes. Logged.
settings.billing.storage.d: It doesn't renew each month: it's what your files take up.
settings.ai.title: *{app}* assistant
settings.ai.onTrack: On track. You'll reach {fecha} *with room to spare*.
settings.ai.tight: Running close. At this pace you'll reach {pct}%.
settings.ai.pace: At this month's pace you reach {pct}%
settings.ai.tokenNote: A token is a small piece of text, roughly three quarters of a word. What you write to the assistant, what it reads to answer you and what it replies: it all counts.
settings.ai.atTop: This month the assistant used all its tokens. Search and actions keep working; AI answers come back on {fecha} or when you add tokens.
settings.data.export.d: We'll email you a file. It may take a few minutes.
settings.data.backups.d: Made {frecuencia}, kept {dias} days. To restore, contact us.
settings.data.delete.d: Everything of yours is deleted except what the law requires us to keep. You have 14 days to change your mind.
asistente.pausado: The assistant used up this month's tokens. Back on {fecha}.
asistente.esAsistente: You're talking to {app}'s assistant, not {persona}. Everything you write is saved to your record.
asistente.sugerencia: suggestion — review it before using it
inicio.noCargo: Couldn't load: {partes}. A zero in those cards does not mean nothing happened.
inicio.pasos.ayuda: Things you do once. Each one crosses itself out when the data exists, and once they're all done this list never comes back.
inicio.widget.alertas.vacio: Nothing to look at today. That feels good.
inicio.ajustar.intro: What you see when you arrive. It is yours and this account's: in another one you can have a different one. To rearrange them and pick their size, tap "Adjust" on Home.
inicio.ajustar.deFabrica.ayuda: Goes back to what {app} suggests for your role — what you see and how it is arranged. If that suggestion changes tomorrow, you get it.
inicio.ajustar.enCurso: Rearrange and pick the size of each card. Nothing is saved until you tap Done.
settings.profile.hint: How your team sees you, and on what you sign.
settings.account.hint: How you sign in and from where. Nobody else sees this.
settings.appearance.hint: How the app looks on this device.
settings.language.hint: The app's and that of the emails we send you.
settings.assistant.hint: What it can do for you, and what it can't.
settings.integrations.hint: What the app connects with your other tools.
settings.privacy.hint: Your data: take it, keep it safe, delete it.
settings.data.hint: What the account is. You change it for the whole team.
settings.notices.hint: What the account sends out, and where.
settings.billing.hint: Your plan, what you use and what the assistant uses.
settings.about.hint: The version, what's new and how to reach us.
settings.security.totp.d.inactivo: Not turned on. It adds a second step when you sign in.
settings.org.name: Name
settings.org.name.d: How it appears to the team and on everything sent out.
papelera.hint: It stays here {dias} days, then it's deleted for good. Until then, you can restore it.
equipo.hint: Who gets into the account and what they can do.
settings.notifications.digest.hour.d: Local time. Unless you change it, at 8:00.
